portal_hypertension.title: Endoscopic Ultrasound-Guided Versus Transjugular Portal Pressure Measurements: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hashimoto R, Tanaka T, Chang KJ
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：已发表的超声内镜引导门静脉压力梯度（EUS-PPG）评论强调了可行性和安全性。 临床提示：我们进行了系统回顾和荟萃分析，专门评估基于 EUS 的门静脉压力测量在前瞻性配对研究中跟踪侵入性比较器测量的紧密程度，并总结一致
portal_hypertension.abstract: Published reviews of endoscopic ultrasound-guided portal pressure gradient (EUS-PPG) have emphasized feasibility and safety. We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis specifically to evaluate how closely EUS-based portal pressure measurements track invasive comparator measurements in prospective paired studies and to summarize agreement, technical success, and adverse events. We searched major databases through January 2026 for prospective cohorts reporting same-patient EUS-based portal pressure measurement and invasive hemodynamic measurements.
